description: CALL Format 2 (program-prototype) - the AS phrase, ISO §2023:14.9.4.2 Format 2 (AS NESTED / AS program-prototype-name-1), introduced 2002 with program prototypes and the NESTED reserved word (§2023:8.9: NESTED reserved from 2002). The FMT-14.9.4.2 row's residue 'the AS-phrase edition gate' re-measured by kb/Work PB239: an 85 compile ACCEPTED `CALL "X" AS NESTED` with no diagnostic. Recognition gate on callAsPhrase. The bare program-prototype-name spelling of Format 2 is the program-prototype-name-2002 row: it needs no REPOSITORY paragraph when the name is the element's own or a containing program definition's (§2023:8.4.6.8), so the REPOSITORY entry's gate cannot stand for it (kb/Work PB4509).

MAIN.
    CALL "CASX2" AS NESTED USING X.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CASX2.
DATA DIVISION.

01 L PIC X(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L.
P.

END PROGRAM CASX2.
END PROGRAM CASX1.
